newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta says imports growth outstrips exports.
newsitem.headline: Malta says imports growth outstrips exports.

text.p: Imports by Malta in June rose to 83.8 million Malta pounds ($206m), an increase of 11 million pounds or 15 percent from the previous month, the Malta Central Office of Statistics(COS)said on Wednesday.

Imports of consumer goods were up by 2.5 million pounds to 20.8 million, industrial supplies rose by 4.3 million pounds to 47.7 million pounds and capital goods were up by 4.2 million to 15.3 million pounds.
Total imports in the first six months of the year reached 502.1 million pounds, up by 8.7 million or 1.8 per cent over the same period last year.
Exports increased by 5.4 million pounds or 10.9 per cent to 55 million pounds. Domestic exports rose by 4.6 million to 49.9 million, and re-exports, by 0.8 million to 5.1 million.
In the January-June period this year, domestic exports declined by 8.9 million, or 3.1 per cent, to 282.8 million when compared to the same period last year.
The drop was caused mainly by lower exports by the machinery and transport sector, the COS said.
But other sectors registered increases in the first six months, particularly food, it said.
